Treat it as a small, short-term experiment alongside simple habits (drink fluids, cut carbonated drinks, watch evening snacks) and note whether symptoms change over 1–2 weeks. If you’re pregnant/nursing, taking medicines, or have new severe pain, blood in stool, weight loss, or persistent changes, check with a clinician rather than relying on a tea.
